notes.text: COST REVISION — SCHEMATIC STUDY ONLY / NOT FOR FABRICATION
CH32V003 replaces fuel gauge and analog RGB circuit. 2 layers intended. Source limiting can reduce selected charge rate.
Charging/protection are hardware controlled. Firmware needed for approximate percentage. GPIO/ADC and current-limit qualification pending.
TARGET: 5V/2A and 3.3V/1A share boost capacity. Power-stage qualification pending. GH7=PWM, GH8=NC.
